summary: September CPI came in hot (headline 3.7% y/y vs 3.6%, core 2.6% vs 2.5%). The 10Y is up to about 5.31%, oil is up and chips and banks are lower pre-market, so SPY leans down from just under its record. The gap is small (-0.3%), so this is a lean, not a conviction.
reasons: CPI 08:30 (CNBC): headline +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y vs 3.6% expected; core 2.6% vs 2.5% expected. Futures turned red after the print (S&P -0.2%, Nasdaq-100 -0.5% in CNBC's snapshot).
